messages:
Maya: Quick AM async — what I did / blockers / today
Maya: Did: finished AZ3 reservation script and pushed to ops-playbooks (PR in review)
Maya: Blocker: noticed two queued jobs stuck in prewarm; seems to be nodes not attaching in AMS region
Maya: Today: want to triage AMS attach issue, then follow up on PR reviews

Liam: Thanks — can you paste the attach logs? quick grep from the autoscaler helps
Liam: Also FYI I bumped the AZ3 buffer from 12 -> 16 last night per surge tests :thumbsup:

Maya: Sure, grabbing logs now
Maya: ```
[autoscaler] 2026-03-17T07:12:03Z WARN attach: instance i-0f... failed to mount: timeout
[autoscaler] 2026-03-17T07:12:23Z INFO retrying attach for i-0f...
[infra] 2026-03-17T07:14:10Z ERROR cni: plugin failed to setup network for pod
```

Anika: @Maya could be the CNI image mismatch we saw last week — did the node image tag change with the reservation spinup?

Maya: I used image: infra-node:2026-03-10 (same as last week). I'll check node agent logs.

Sam: If it's CNI, rolling the daemonset quick patch on AMS should be fine. Want me to cut a canary patch? I can route 5% traffic to patched nodes.

Maya: Yes please, Sam. Start with canary in AMS zone 'ams-2a' only.

Sam: On it. kubectl patch daemonset cni -n kube-system --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"cni:v1.7.3-fix"}]'
Sam: I'll ping when ready :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment sam/cni-patch started — canary 5% (ams-2a) — rollout id r-7834

Liam: One more note: quotas team says we have 18/20 reserved for AMS GPUs in prod, but 2 are pending approval for the new AZ. If canary needs extra capacity might hit pending limits.

Maya: Good catch. Can you DM quota@internal to prioritize those two? @Liam

Liam: Yep, just did. Ticket #Q-2987

Anika: Quick thought — if attach fails due to CNI we should avoid node termination loop by adjusting scale-down grace to 10m for AMS until patch stabilizes.

Maya: Agree. I'll update autoscaler policy to min-unready-time=600s for AMS region.

Sam: Canary patch is live for ams-2a, monitoring logs now. Will report in 10m.

Maya: Thanks. After canary if green I'll merge the reservation PR and run 2x drain tests in staging.

Sam: Canary looks good — no new cni errors in last 8m
Sam: Rollout green, proceeding to 50% now :thumbsup:

Maya: Awesome. I'll do the autoscaler change and then merge the PR. Might ping infra oncall if anything odd.

Liam: FYI I'm going to start a short runbook note in ops-playbooks/ams/attach-issues.md with the steps we took.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Today: finish PR, autoscaler tweak, run drains in staging. Blocker resolved for now.

Anika: thx, marking as resolved on my side — leave a short blurb in the ticket.

Sam: +1
deploy-bot: Thread archived after 45m of inactivity
